items.title: ‘We had the worst fight’: I want my husband to retire at 65, but I don’t want to lose his $280,000 salary. Is that unreasonable?
items.description: “We have $2.6 million, most of it in his 401(k) and IRAs, plus $450,000 in a brokerage account.”

items.title: China’s hottest stocks these days have one thing in common: names that sound like sheep
items.description: Shares of fish processors, lighting manufacturers and appliance makers have soared ahead of the Year of the Sheep. Investor appetite has had little to do with the status of their businesses.

items.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
items.description: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”

items.title: Nvidia is gearing up for one of Wall Street’s most anticipated earnings calls in years
items.description: Jensen Huang’s sudden departure has made Tuesday’s earnings call “the most important in the company’s history.”

items.title: ‘The thought of living to 100 terrifies me’: Is Social Security a giant Ponzi scheme?
items.description: There is already a demographic ‘run’ on Social Security.

items.title: Will the Anthropic IPO create a disturbance in the broader U.S. equity market, like SpaceX did?
items.description: SpaceX’s offering coincided with the June peak in semiconductors.

items.title: Should a widow leave her late partner’s home to her stepkids — or cut off contact with them?
items.description: “It would be a less drastic step than selling the home now and splitting the proceeds.”

items.title: The U.S. is turning more socialist under Trump 2.0, one analyst says. What could change with a Democratic-run Congress?
items.description: A handy chart shows how the U.S. used to be among the economies with the least state control — until that changed last year.

items.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
items.description: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

items.title: Gold and silver are supposed to protect against inflation. So why are both metals tumbling instead?
items.description: Charts show the potential for more pain ahead
